rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for saying that a man or boy is handsome.

example.jyutping: nei5 go3 zai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3 zai2 wo3

rows.note: Use 高 when describing a salary as high or generous in everyday speech, as in 份人工好高.

example.english: This job offers a really handsome salary.
example.traditional: 呢份工嘅人工真係好高。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 jan4 gung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 gou1
